pkgmetadata.longdescription: Schiefer: Motif/CDE look for KDE Plasma based on Breeze (meta package).

use.flag: Pull in x11-themes/schiefer-backdrop: wallpaper plugin with a pattern and color per virtual desktop
Pull in x11-themes/schiefer-dock: dock widgets in the style of the CDE front panel
Pull in x11-themes/schiefer-icons: Breeze icons in muted CDE/Motif colors
Pull in x11-themes/schiefer-kde: window decoration and Qt widget style
Pull in x11-themes/schiefer-plymouth: boot screen (Plymouth theme and dracut module)
Pull in x11-themes/schiefer-themes: color schemes, Plasma style, GTK theme, cursors, window switcher, wallpaper, Konsole colors
